findings.entity: Syriatel (Syrian mobile operator) - official new-SYP recharge denominations
findings.chain_layer: Operator/issuer (Syriatel) -> recharge channel (Abili dealer line / Syriatel Cash / agent - unidentified) -> HalabTech -> Customer
findings.claim: All seven current HalabTech Syriatel SKUs are Syriatel's own official recharge denominations in new SYP (credited units before tax), whose tax-inclusive prices are 32, 55, 150, 220, 385, 990 and 2,500 SYP; the 'divide by 1.04' pattern is Syriatel's tax, not a supplier fee.
findings.excerpt: فئة التعبئة السعر بعد إضافة الضرائب ... 144.23 150 ل.س ... 951.92 990 ل.س ... 2403.84 2,500 ل.س ... الأسعار بالليرة الجديدة السورية
findings.alternative_explanations: HalabTech may have taken the list from an upstream Syrian top-up API that itself mirrors Syriatel's table. Against that: HalabTech rounds half-up (30.77, 211.54, 2403.85) while Syriatel's table truncates (30.76, 211.53, 2403.84), so HalabTech probably computed gross/1.04 itself.
findings.contradicting_evidence: None for the naming provenance. The fulfilment intermediary is still unidentified (see W7-02).
findings.what_would_confirm: For the supply step: a Syrian recharge provider's dealer/API list naming HalabTech, or HalabTech stating it recharges through its own Syriatel Cash/Abili line.
findings.what_would_reject: An upstream API catalog using the identical rounded strings (30.77/211.54/2403.85 SYP [Syria Country]) earlier than HalabTech's relaunch posts.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Resolves D-30's open question: 150/1.04 = 144.23 etc. is Syriatel's tax, not a provider fee. D-30's 'unidentified supplier' remains open.
findings.notes: The page says recharge is done via 'خطوط عبيلي; أجهزة الخدمة الذاتية; مراكز الخدمة' (dealer Abili lines, self-service kiosks, service centres). HalabTech prices imply about 93-104 new SYP per USD before margin ($1.49/150, $23.99/2500, $9.69/990, $0.32/32). Its MTN SKUs (100-2000 LS) imply about 67-87 SYP/USD, i.e. priced 15-35% higher per SYP than Syriatel. Older Syriatel/MTN SKUs from Dec 2024 (Syriatel 2013/4026/10067/15000/20000/26043/50000 SYP, posts 32932-32938) and earlier undated ones (500/1000/1500/4506/16011 SYP) probably followed the pre-redenomination official table; not verified.

findings.what_would_confirm: A supplier price list where 60 UC = $0.90 (or another exact divisor) on the same day, or a HalabTech order reply naming the API.

findings.entity: Unidentified TRY-denominated e-pin / TL top-up source (candidates: Turkpin dealer API, Oyuneks Bayi API, Pinmarkt, ExePin, shop2topup, apikontor/cepkontor)

findings.claim: All six Google Play (Turkey) prices equal face TL x 0.021174 USD (implied 47.227 TRY/USD), about 4.1-4.3% above face at market FX (49.18-49.26 TRY/USD, Oct 6-9 2026). That fingerprints a face-value-linked TRY source with automatic currency conversion. iTunes-TR and PayCell/Turkcell/TT prices are manual or stale. Turkpin's dealer API supports both e-pins and 'GSM TL top up', covering the whole group mix, but no supplier is proven.
findings.excerpt: Turkpin.com API ... you must have: An active dealer account ... Please enter correct operator and phone number for GSM TL top up
findings.alternative_explanations: HalabTech (Turkish IBAN, 19 Turkish agents) may buy cards manually at Turkish retail/dealer shops and set a TRY rate in Dhru itself. The linear price then reflects HalabTech's own FX setting, not a supplier.
findings.contradicting_evidence: PayCell/Turkcell/TT prices imply 22-33 TRY/USD (stale, 2023-early 2025 levels), which suggests manual pricing for top-ups.
findings.what_would_confirm: A Turkish dealer price list giving Google Play TL at face x k such that k x (HalabTech markup) reproduces 0.021174 on the same day.
findings.what_would_reject: Non-linear HalabTech GP-TR prices on another day (linearity is the fingerprint).
